title: Enhancing Road Coordination Through Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) Communication
summary: OptM describes controlled pilots of vehicle communication and AI coordination. Safer journeys, smoother traffic, and lower emissions remain expected.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: OptM describes controlled road pilots of vehicle communication and AI coordination. Safer journeys, smoother traffic, and lower emissions remain expected.
purpose: Help vehicles coordinate safely on constrained roads.

ratings.reason: Drivers and other road users are intended to gain safer road coordination.
Smoother traffic and lower emissions are intended, without a measured public outcome.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: Enhancing Road Coordination Through Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) Communication

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Vehicle positioning, sensors, and interoperable V2V communication

headline: V2V coordination for narrow and congested roads
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
